description: This file defines the PooledBufferStream class, a custom Stream implementation that uses object pooling and buffer segmentation for efficient memory management in serialization contexts within Orleans framework.

classes.name: PooledBufferStream
classes.description: A Stream implementation that uses object pooling and buffer segmentation for efficient serialization buffer management.

classes.name: PooledBufferStream.BufferSegment
classes.description: A segment class used internally for managing parts of the pooled buffer in a linked sequence.

methods.name: PooledBufferStream
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of PooledBufferStream with optional minimum allocation size.

methods.name: Rent
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of PooledBufferStream from the object pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns a PooledBufferStream instance to the object pool.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Returns the written data as a byte array.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the buffer contents to a provided IBufferWriter.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer, returning segments to the pool and clearing internal state.

methods.name: RentReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> representing the written data, for use in serialization.

methods.name: ReturnReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a previously rented ReadOnlySequence<byte> to the buffer pool.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Changes the stream position based on offset and origin.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into a buffer.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the stream, truncating or extending buffers as needed.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the stream, managing buffer segments.
